notes: Implement Stage 3 vertical slice: git worktrees with single-writer path locking, local L0 advisor with strict skip-on-unavailable, and CLI daemon with Unix domain socket attach. Real Pi workers only (pi --print --mode json). Do not modify Pi core. No silent fallback to paid cloud models.

tasks.title: Implement git worktree isolation and path-prefix locks
tasks.objective: Implement PathLockManager and WorktreeManager under src/worktree/. Isolate code tasks in worktrees/<taskId>, report changes relative to worktree root, enforce single-writer on shared path prefixes, and add comprehensive unit tests in test/worktree.test.ts.
constraints: Non-code tasks remain read-only in main workspace.
Orchestrator must never auto-merge git branches.
AgentReport.changes.files must be relative to worktree root.
tasks.expectedOutput: PathLockManager and WorktreeManager implemented with passing test/worktree.test.ts.

tasks.title: Implement local L0 advisor with skip-on-unavailable
tasks.objective: Implement L0Advisor in src/l0/advisor.ts using OllamaProvider (gemma4:latest). Provide classify, compressSummary, and recommendReasoning. If Ollama is unavailable, emit l0.skipped telemetry and fall back to deterministic rules. Add tests in test/l0.test.ts.
constraints: Advisory only: L0 must not spawn child processes, edit files, or invoke tools.
No silent paid fallback: if Ollama is down, skip and continue with deterministic rules.
Timeout on L0 queries must not exceed 1500ms.
tasks.expectedOutput: L0Advisor module with skip-and-log resilience and passing test/l0.test.ts.

tasks.title: Implement CLI daemon, Unix socket IPC, and SQLite store
tasks.objective: Implement Store interface in src/daemon/store.ts and Unix socket IPC server in src/daemon/server.ts. Update CLI main.ts with daemon command and adapt extensions/index.ts to attach over socket with clean abort on session_shutdown. Add test/daemon.test.ts.
constraints: Local Unix domain socket only, no remote network exposure.
Clean process group signal escalation on session_shutdown.
tasks.expectedOutput: Daemon server, SQLite store, thin extension attach, and passing test/daemon.test.ts.

tasks.title: Verify Stage 3 integration and test suite
tasks.objective: Run full test suite, lint, and typecheck. Confirm zero regressions, zero Pi core modifications, and end-to-end functionality of worktrees, L0 advisor, and daemon runner.
constraints: All tests, linter, and typecheck must pass cleanly.
tasks.expectedOutput: Clean test, lint, and typecheck run logs with Stage 3 summary.
